_metadata.description: Requirements for Code Facts discovery, contract evaluation, findings, command execution, and autofix.

requirements.title: Discover scenario surfaces through Code Facts
requirements.description: AuditQuality resolves the target scenario through Code Facts and builds a normalized surface inventory before applying any language/framework contracts.

validation.notes: Use a fake Code Facts client to prove discovered surfaces drive contract matching and unavailable discovery returns a degraded audit.

requirements.title: Evaluate migrated static-quality contracts
requirements.description: The contract registry evaluates every migrated Tidiness Manager / Scenario Auditor rule ID with equal or stronger semantics and without template-level policy coupling.

validation.notes: Fixture tests cover positive and negative cases for all ten migrated rule IDs.

requirements.title: Enforce protective config comments
requirements.description: TypeScript and ESLint config checks fail when strict values are present but required safety-critical agent guidance comments are missing.

validation.notes: Negative fixtures prove strict tsconfig and ESLint safety rules fail without the required comments.

requirements.title: Emit stable agent-readable findings
requirements.description: Audit responses include stable finding IDs, severity, path evidence, expected and observed values, why-it-matters text, remediation, command evidence, next steps, and maturity summary.

validation.notes: Golden response tests assert deterministic finding IDs and maturity rung transitions.

requirements.title: Preview safe config autofixes
requirements.description: FixConfig returns deterministic config file edit previews by default and only applies supported edits when the caller explicitly requests apply mode.

validation.notes: Temp-directory tests prove dry-run leaves files untouched, apply mutates only supported config files, and protective comments are inserted or preserved.
